t.zh: 检查台判断得了答案，却碰不到图里的一个数。工作台从这里补起：相机把光变成数，计算机存下的就是这些数。这一章的灰度图里，0 是黑，1 是白，中间的数是不同深浅的灰。
t.en: The station could judge answers but could not touch a single number of an image. The workbench starts here: the camera turns light into numbers, and those numbers are what the computer stores. In this chapter's grey images 0 is black, 1 is white and the numbers between are shades of grey.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：相机拍下的这张小图，存进计算机是什么样子？照着画面把每个像素的数填进格子；格子摆成什么形状，图就存成什么形状。
t.en: This level asks: what does this small picture from the camera look like once it is stored in the computer? Following the picture, fill in each pixel's number; the shape of the grid is the shape the image is stored in.

after.zh: 灰度图存成 高 × 宽 的<wiki-ref to="image-array"></wiki-ref>，彩色图每格存三个数。
after.en: A grey image is stored as a height × width <wiki-ref to="image-array"></wiki-ref>; a colour image holds three numbers a cell.

brief.zh: 照着画面，把这张 3 像素宽、2 像素高的灰度图存成一格格的数。
brief.en: Following the picture, store this grey image, 3 pixels wide and 2 high, as cells of numbers.

hint.zh: 画面里只有三种颜色：黑、中灰、白。
hint.en: The picture holds only three shades: black, mid grey and white.

why.zh: 这是按 宽 × 高 抄的：画面的第一行像素抄成了格子的第一列。数组先写高、再写宽，格子的第 y 行就是画面的第 y 行。
why.en: This is copied as width × height: the picture's first row went into the grid's first column. An array lists height first, then width; row y of the grid is row y of the picture.

brief.zh: 再存一张 2 像素宽、3 像素高的灰度图。
brief.en: Now store a grey image 2 pixels wide and 3 high.

hint.zh: 画面里的一行像素，存成格子里的哪一行？
hint.en: Which row of the grid does a row of pixels in the picture go to?

why.zh: 这张图 2 像素宽、3 像素高，抄出来却是 2 行 3 列：行和列对调了，每一行要是画面里的一行像素。
why.en: The image is 2 pixels wide and 3 high, but this copy has 2 rows of 3: rows and columns are swapped, and each row must be one row of the picture's pixels.

t.zh: 彩色图的每个像素存三个数 (R, G, B)：红、绿、蓝各有多亮，各在 0 到 1 之间。
t.en: Each pixel of a colour image stores three numbers (R, G, B): how bright its red, green and blue are, each from 0 to 1.

brief.zh: 把第二行正中间那个像素改成纯蓝，别的格子不动。
brief.en: Turn the middle pixel of the second row pure blue, leaving every other cell as it is.

hint.zh: 纯蓝：蓝色最亮，红和绿一点也没有。
hint.en: Pure blue: the blue at its brightest, no red and no green at all.

why.zh: 只把 (1, 1) 的蓝色调到 1，得到 (1, 1, 1)，那是白色：纯蓝还要红和绿都是 0。
why.en: Raising only the blue number of (1, 1) gives (1, 1, 1), which is white: pure blue also needs its red and green at 0.
